title: Getting on the Same Wavelength: Attachment and Attunement
coreMove: Regulation grows through repeated attunement: read the signal, respond predictably, repair ruptures, and remember that fear inside the caregiving bond scrambles safety and agency.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a child's threat map may be dismissed as mere fantasy
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: an ambiguous story is read as a relational map rather than random imagination

exampleSpecs.stakes: a child's protest can be misread as defiance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: attachment behavior is treated as survival signaling

exampleSpecs.stakes: quiet self-protection can masquerade as independence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: avoidant strategy is recognized as adaptation, not toughness

exampleSpecs.stakes: behavior labels can obscure approach-and-fear conflict
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: disorganized attachment is framed as an unsolvable conflict

exampleSpecs.stakes: discipline can miss the child's expected story
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a story around an ambiguous image exposes expected danger

exampleSpecs.stakes: support can become shame unless rhythm changes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: caregiver training becomes trauma prevention through synchrony
